_meta.what: Where a new business could work in Niagara Falls today, if anywhere.
_meta.rule: a newcomer the size of the median business of its kind sells at least 1.3x the median business of its kind already in the city, in every scenario, and keeps a profit margin after rent on that street
_meta.caution: A single site's sales forecast can be off by up to about x3.6 either way (data/forecast_error.json); comparisons between spots and kinds are more reliable than the dollar figures.
